questions.question: 1. When analyzing a polished and etched metallurgical sample under a microscope, what features are made visible for measuring grain size?

2. You have drawn five random lines while using the Intercept Method to measure grain size. If the total length of 250 mm on a micrograph and count 100 grain boundary intercepts. If the magnification is 200×, what is the mean intercept length (L) in micrometers (µm)?
3. Which tool is used in ‘comparison method’ for grain size measurement:
4. A higher ASTM grain size number (n) corresponds to:

answers.a: bigger grains and different number at 100× magnification
answers.b: smaller grains and different number at 100× magnification
answers.c: same grain size, but magnification of observation is higher
answers.d: same grain size, but magnification of observation is lower

questions.question: 5. What is a major disadvantage of the intercept method for measuring grain size?

answers.a: It is only applicable to grain size bigger than 100µm
answers.b: It does not provide information about the grain shape
answers.c: It is a very time-consuming process
answers.d: It overestimates the true grain size
